title: Number Hunt
description: Find the secret number in as few guesses as you can.
intro: I'm thinking of a number from 1 to {high}. After each guess I'll tell you whether my number is higher or lower. Find it in as few guesses as you can.
first_counts: Your first attempt is the one that counts on the scoreboard.
practice_now: You've already played your counted attempt, so this one is practice.
perfect: A perfect strategy needs at most {n} guesses.
guess_range: Guess a whole number from {low} to {high}.
too_low: {n} is too low. My number is higher.
too_high: {n} is too high. My number is lower.
summary_one: The number was {n}. You took 1 guess in {time}.
summary: The number was {n}. You took {guesses} guesses in {time}.
practice: This was practice: your first attempt is the one that counts.
rank: You're number {rank} of {of} on the scoreboard.
time_up_text: You ran out of time on this attempt.
